GRIEVANCE X ◆ THE FRANCHISE

He has pressed states to surrender the rolls of their electors to a central authority asserting unproven fraud.

THE RECORD SHOWS

The Justice Department has pursued voter-registration records and alleged noncitizen registrations, drawing legal defeats and objections from state officials.

Officials say they are enforcing the prohibition on noncitizen voting. State election administrators and voting-rights advocates dispute the scale of alleged fraud and challenge the breadth and legality of federal demands. One federal judge ruled a DOJ use of voter rolls unlawful in October.

A DOCUMENTED SEQUENCE

3 MILESTONES
  1. 2025–26The Justice Department requested extensive state voter-registration records and cross-checked them against immigration data.
  2. October 9, 2026A district judge held a DOJ use of voter-roll data unlawful and highlighted the risk of misidentifying eligible citizens.
  3. October 17, 2026Trump threatened imprisonment of California officials in a dispute over mail-ballot practices; California officials disputed his account.

WHAT THE RECORD DOES NOT ESTABLISH

The DOJ press release presents the administration’s allegation, not independently verified proof of the stated number of noncitizens. The court ruling addresses a particular data-matching practice.
